title: A held update becomes invisible when a topic's Flashcards tab gives way to Quiz (or the deck is remounted after Edit › Done): no chip, no run line, nothing applied
detail: Topic #/ref/compsci/4.5.2.1, Flashcards tab open (deck mounted, no card rated). A pull moves progress for this topic: the run line reads 'Updated on another device · it applies when this run ends' and no chip is made. Tap the Quiz tab: KOS.changes.pending() stays {source:'device', why:'task'} but the page shows no chip and the quiz's own run line is hidden and empty (E2: chip null, runLine null). The same after the study editor's Done on the Flashcards tab (the deck remounts with a fresh hidden line). The change only lands when the reader opens a tab without a run (Exam, Notes) or leaves. Measured twice at ipad and split. Expected (165): the chip, or the run line, says what is held for as long as it is held.
rootCause: js/core/redraw.js:513-521 — showChip() writes into the run slot and returns before paintChip(), so no chip exists; js/engines/flashcards.js:189 and js/engines/quiz.js:206 mount every new deck/quiz with a hidden, empty [data-run-line] and never call KOS.changes.place() on mount (only at finish, flashcards.js:469, quiz.js:337); the tab click's safePoint (redraw.js:595-600) refuses because runSlot() is truthy (redraw.js:591) and does not re-show anything.
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/sync-disruption/t4.js output (ipad and split): E1 runLine set, E2 {chip:null, runLine:null, pending:{why:'task'}}, E3 applied on Exam tab; t2.js/p4.js: after editor Done {rl:[{hidden:true, txt:''}], chip:null, held:{count:1, areas:{edits:1}}}
fix: When safePoint() refuses (or on every tab click with pending), call showChip(); or have the flashcard and quiz engines call KOS.changes.place() once when they mount their heldLine.

title: The held-update chip squeezes a topic's title row: the title and breadcrumb rewrap and the notes jump down 54–125 px under the reader when a pull arrives
detail: On a topic page scrolled to the top (#/ref/compsci/4.5.4.3, #/ref/code/1.3), a pull that the page reads shows the 257 px chip in the title row. The title (and the breadcrumb under it) rewraps to more lines, so the notes body moves down while the reader is reading it: CS topic notes y 373→427 (ipad), 319→373 (ipadl), 257→347 (mac); Code 1.3 at ipad the header grows 85→210 px and the notes move 316→441 (title on three lines, breadcrumb on two). Split (590) does not move. Further down the page Chrome's scroll anchoring hides it, but at the top nothing compensates (and Safari's anchoring is weaker). Reproduced on each run (twice per size). Invariant 165 says nothing moves under the reader; the chip itself moves the page.
rootCause: js/core/redraw.js:483 chipHost() puts the chip in `.k-topic-head .k-topic-steps` (inserted before ‹ ›, :527); css/views/study.css:186/193 — .k-topic-head is a flex row and .k-topic-steps takes its content width from the title column, so a 257 px chip narrows the title by that much.
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/sync-disruption/topic-chip-shift-mac-dense.png; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/sync-disruption/code-lesson-chip-ipad-dense.png; t11.js {h0:85.2, h1:210.3, notesY0:316, notesY1:441} (ipad), split unchanged; t12.js per size
fix: Give the chip a slot that does not share the title's row width: absolutely position it in the head's actions corner, reserve its inline space up front (the steps' min-inline-size), or ride the tabs row/foot as the phone does; then a chip appearing never reflows the title.

title: Focus's set-up form (mode, subject, nudge, limit) resets to the last session's settings when another device's or tab's session lands
detail: #/focus with no session running. Pick Stopwatch, a 90-minute nudge and the subject Maths (nothing started yet), wait 4.5 s, then a pull that adds a session from another device (sessions moved). The page redraws at once (not a task page, nothing held) and the form comes back as Pomodoro 25/5, nudge 50, subject '' — measured twice (ipad, mac): before {mode:'Stopwatch', ns:'90', subj:'maths'} → after {mode:'Pomodoro 25 / 5', ns:'50', subj:''}. Only the typed objective survives (the typed-text rule). The reader who then taps Start runs a session with the wrong mode and no subject (its pay and the subject's study time follow the subject, invariant 4a).
rootCause: js/modules/focus.js:2263-2290 — the set-up is rebuilt on every render from F().lastConfig (cfg) and held only in the render's closure and controls; js/core/redraw.js:75 READS.focus includes sessions/governor/progress, and focus is neither in TASK (redraw.js:102) nor guarded by KOS.view.hold, so a background change redraws the form at once (redraw.js:657); restore() puts back only text fields (redraw.js:273-277), never selects or the mode buttons.
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/sync-disruption/f3.js output (ipad, mac); f2.js (objective kept, nudge select reverted 90→50)
fix: Keep the unsaved set-up in KOS.view.memo('focus.setup') (seeded from lastConfig once per visit) so a redraw draws the reader's choices, or KOS.view.hold() while the form differs from lastConfig.
